intro: A plate of char kuey teow is roughly 740 kcal (estimate). The high calories come from the slippery, oily flat noodles and the lots of oil used for high-heat frying.

variants.name: Char kuey teow with duck egg

diet: Yes, but treat it as a 'treat' meal. 740 kcal is close to half the daily needs of many women trying to lose weight. Once a week is plenty. On CKT days, keep your other meals light and high in protein.
tips: Share one plate with a friend and add a plate of veg.
Ask for less oil and more bean sprouts.
Go for the small size if there is one. The difference can be nearly 200 kcal.

swap.name: Kuey teow sup
swap.why: Same kuey teow, but in soup. Less than half the calories.

faq.q: Why does Penang char kuey teow taste different?
faq.a: Penang hawkers usually cook over very high heat to get 'wok hei', add cockles and prawns, and use less sweet kicap than other versions.

faq.q: Is there halal char kuey teow?
faq.a: Plenty. Some original versions use pork lard, so choose halal-certified shops or Malay and mamak stalls.

faq.q: Can I make char kuey teow at home?
faq.a: Yes. Use a non-stick pan and just 1 tablespoon of oil. It may have less 'wok hei' but it's still tasty.
